title: 6.8 Following Directions
unit_outcome: Name places and transport, explain a current destination, complete a trip, follow directions, ask for help, choose a service and check its times.
goal: Follow a short, ordered route to a destination, with an instruction and visible consequence at each step.
grammar_function: Luis gives Ana a route from the hotel to the museum: go straight, go past the bank, turn left at the corner, cross at the reviewed crossing and stop at the museum. Ana follows it. Only after this route ends does a short, explicitly separate route to the movie theater practise turn right.
prerequisite: Units 1–5 and the earlier Unit 6 lessons in the displayed course sequence.
speaking_outcome: Follow a short, ordered route to a destination, with an instruction and visible consequence at each step.
